body.x: FEELS(www.myphil.com) showcased ‘EAR 93.9’ for smartphones at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
‘EAR 93.9' is premium in-ear earphone optimized for channel FM93.9, CBS radio.

The newly developed 3D head applying product is 360-degree rotating that gives comfortable feel and ensures easy wearing for long time. It also provides clean sound and is equipped with a mice for voice call.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
